name: social-1: the party size ladder (pair and three lowered, the four held)
why: 57-review-social R3. On one tier a pair is paid as much a head as a four or more (ground-rates 1c92d6bc7). Ruling 50-8 wants a pair at 1.2 to 1.5 of a lone hero, a three at 1.5 to 2.0, a four at 1.8 to 2.5. This lowers every pair cell by 0.77 and every three cell by 0.85 and holds the four. It targets the party-over-lone bands; any moved survival or gold band is UNINTENDED.
